module sorted.merge
  purpose: Merge sorted integer lists without duplicates.

public function merge_sorted_unique(left: List of Integer, right: List of Integer)
  returns List of Integer
  purpose: Merge two sorted lists of Integers into one sorted list without duplicates.
  example: merge_sorted_unique(left: [1, 3, 5], right: [2, 3, 4]) is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
  example: merge_sorted_unique(left: [], right: []) is []

  let result be []
  let i be 0
  let j be 0

  repeat until i is at least left.length and j is at least right.length
    if left.at(i) is less than right.at(j) then
      if result.is_empty or result.last is not left.at(i) then
        set result to result.append(left.at(i))
      end
      set i to i + 1
    otherwise if right.at(j) is less than left.at(i) then
      if result.is_empty or result.last is not right.at(j) then
        set result to result.append(right.at(j))
      end
      set j to j + 1
    otherwise
      if result.is_empty or result.last is not left.at(i) then
        set result to result.append(left.at(i))
      end
      set i to i + 1
      set j to j + 1
    end
  end

  repeat until i is at least left.length
    if result.is_empty or result.last is not left.at(i) then
      set result to result.append(left.at(i))
    end
    set i to i + 1
  end

  repeat until j is at least right.length
    if result.is_empty or result.last is not right.at(j) then
      set result to result.append(right.at(j))
    end
    set j to j + 1
  end

  return result
end

test "merging two empty lists returns an empty list"
  check merge_sorted_unique(left: [], right: []) is []
end

  purpose: Merge two sorted lists of Integers into one sorted list without duplicates.

  example: merge_unique(left: [], right: []) is []

  let result be []
  let mutable left_index be 0
  let mutable right_index be 0

  repeat until left_index is at least left.length and right_index is at least right.length
    if left_index is at least left.length then
      let right_value be right.at(right_index)
      if result.is_empty or result.last is not right_value then
        set result to result.append(right_value)
      end
      set right_index to right_index + 1
    otherwise if right_index is at least right.length then
      let left_value be left.at(left_index)
      if result.is_empty or result.last is not left_value then
        set result to result.append(left_value)
      end
      set left_index to left_index + 1
    otherwise
      let left_value be left.at(left_index)
      let right_value be right.at(right_index)

      if left_value is less than right_value then
        if result.is_empty or result.last is not left_value then
          set result to result.append(left_value)

        set left_index to left_index + 1

      end

module sorted_lists
  purpose: Merge sorted integer lists without duplicates.

public function merge_unique(left: List of Integer, right: List of Integer)
  returns List of Integer
  purpose: Merge two sorted lists of Integers into one sorted list without duplicates.
  example: merge_unique(left: [1, 2, 4], right: [2, 3, 4]) is [1, 2, 3, 4]
  example: merge_unique(left: [], right: []) is []

  let result: List of Integer be []
  let mutable i be 0
  let mutable j be 0

  repeat until i is at least left.length() and j is at least right.length()
    if i is at least left.length() then
      let value be right.at(j)
      if result.is_empty() or result.last() is not value then
        set result to result.append(value)
      end
      set j to j + 1
    otherwise if j is at least right.length() then
      let value be left.at(i)
      if result.is_empty() or result.last() is not value then
        set result to result.append(value)
      end
      set i to i + 1
    otherwise
      let left_value be left.at(i)
      let right_value be right.at(j)

      if left_value is less than right_value then
        if result.is_empty() or result.last() is not left_value then
          set result to result.append(left_value)
        end
        set i to i + 1
      otherwise if right_value is less than left_value then
        if result.is_empty() or result.last() is not right_value then
          set result to result.append(right_value)
        end
        set j to j + 1
      otherwise
        if result.is_empty() or result.last() is not left_value then
          set result to result.append(left_value)
        end
        set i to i + 1
        set j to j + 1
      end
    end
  end

  return result
end
